title: Siddaramaiah maintains studied silence over Cabinet expansion
content: Former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has maintained a studied silence amid growing indications that he is unhappy with the list of 19 Ministers inducted into the D.K. Shivakumar Cabinet, even as several of his supporters openly criticised the Chief Minister and the Congress high command

title: Jharkhand exam protest enters day 7, aspirants demand CBI probe
content: The protest by job aspirants in Jharkhand over alleged irregularities in the JPSC and JSSC-CGL examinations has entered its seventh day. Protesters are demanding a CBI probe or an independent inquiry, claiming they have lost faith in the ongoing CID investigation.

content: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan grant the interim stay pursuant to petitions filed by two more accused for a Central Bureau of Investigation probe

title: Explained: Why FSSAI has cracked down on Dabur’s ‘100%’ product claims
content: Why has FSSAI directed Dabur to stop selling products carrying claims such as ‘100% Natural’ and ‘100% Pure’? In this explainer, we break down the regulator’s objections, the rules governing food labels, and what the action means for consumers and the FMCG industry.

title: Students allege spoiled food served at AU hostel; V-C orders stricter monitoring
content: Students carry vessel containing alleged spoiled egg curry to the Vice-Chancellor’s office, prompting the university to introduce daily food inspections, student participation in monitoring and stricter accountability for staff and suppliers

title: ‘No insurance, no fuel’: SC directs govt to prepare pilot project
content: The Supreme Court has initiated a pilot project that connects fuel supply to the vehicle's insurance status, aiming to enhance adherence to mandatory third-party insurance laws. Additionally, the court has extended the insurance requirement period for new vehicles, intending to ensure that accident victims receive prompt compensation. Monitoring compliance will be supported by automatic number plate recognition cameras.

title: Day after PK's poll win, PM Modi talks to Nabin, meets Nitish
content: During a recent NDA meeting, government officials emphasized the importance of economic growth and the creation of jobs. The event also saw discussions surrounding India's evolving sports landscape. Prime Minister Modi and Amit Shah were present, and a humorous exchange between Modi and Nitin Nabin generated buzz among the MPs. Subsequently, Modi held discussions with former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar and his JDU associates.

title: Pakistan boxer Qudratullah ‘goes missing’ in Glasgow after CWG campaign
content: Pakistani boxer Qudratullah reportedly went missing in Glasgow hours before the national team’s departure, with his passport and return ticket remaining with the team manager. Pakistan finished the Commonwealth Games with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra. Her historic achievement made her the first Pakistani female boxer to win a CWG medal, while Arshad Nadeem missed out.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: 274 fugitives brought back from 36 nations since 2019
content: Government brought back 274 fugitives from 36 countries since 2019. Assets worth over Rs 17,874 crore were attached during this period. This contrasts with the UPA government's record of fewer extraditions annually. Legal frameworks were updated, and diplomatic efforts intensified for fugitive recovery. This approach reflects a coordinated "whole of government" strategy for justice.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
content: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance for marine health. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vast Pacific waters and their ecosystems.

title: Illinois farmhouse becomes final training ground for 100 firefighters
content: A four-generation family farmhouse in Illinois was given a meaningful final purpose before being demolished. The Kestel family donated the vacant house to the New Lenox Fire Protection District, where nearly 100 firefighters trained in realistic live-fire rescue and firefighting exercises over three days. Although watching the home burn was emotional, the family said knowing it helped firefighters gain life-saving experience made its final farewell a fitting tribute to their family's legacy of community service.

title: Over half of infected Caribbean corals resisted widespread bleaching
content: In the Caribbean, researchers are exploring the use of predatory bacteria as a means to combat coral diseases. Laboratory tests have demonstrated that these microscopic bacteria can successfully eliminate harmful Vibrio bacteria while preserving the coral's vital microbiome. This promising method provides a focused mechanism to defend corals against disease. However, additional field trials are necessary for its application in conservation efforts.

title: US may raise H-1B, L-1 visa fees for large employers under DHS proposal
content: The US government plans to expand an additional visa fee. This fee currently applies to certain large employers filing H-1B and L-1 petitions. The planned change will extend this charge to visa extension requests. Qualifying employers with over fifty employees and a majority in H-1B or L-1 status will be affected. This expansion aims to fund biometric entry-exit system improvements and other government programs.

title: 'No double meaning in my speech; TN CM using diversion tactic,' says Udhayanidhi
content: Udhayanidhi Stalin faced arrest over alleged remarks linked to actor Trisha. The Madras High Court directed his release on station bail after questioning. DMK workers staged protests across Tamil Nadu following the arrest. The TVK government and opposition engaged in a war of words. Udhayanidhi denied allegations and stated his remarks were distorted.

title: EU eyes tougher border controls after Ceuta migrant surge triggers alarm
content: European Union ministers are demanding stricter measures against migrant smuggling networks.  They also seek stronger return policies following a large influx into Ceuta.  The bloc is enhancing border security and intelligence sharing with external partners.  Disinformation by smugglers fueled the unprecedented migration surge into the Spanish enclave.  This crisis has reignited divisions within the European Union over migration management.

title: After opening golf tournament, CM Omar says authorities must not allow repeat of migrant worker killings
content: Omar Abdullah, the chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir, strongly condemned the recent violence against migrant laborers, emphasizing that such acts are unacceptable and calling for heightened security measures. He also underscored the significance of golf tournaments as a means to boost tourism in the area, recalling a time when these events were a hallmark of Kashmir's serene landscape, well before militancy took root.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey from poverty to football greatness
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.

title: Top 5 greatest UFC lightweight champions of all time ranked
content: Khabib Nurmagomedov leads the list of greatest UFC lightweight champions. Islam Makhachev continues the Dagestani tradition of excellence with his dominant reign. Charles Oliveira transformed into a dangerous finisher after a remarkable comeback story. Justin Gaethje earned his place with a fearless fighting style and exciting battles. B.J. Penn, a Hall of Famer, pioneered the division's growth.

title: 6-year-old with heart condition scores dream Panthers touchdown
content: Six-year-old Asher Harvey, who was born with a complex heart condition and has undergone multiple heart surgeries, fulfilled his dream of becoming a Carolina Panthers player for a day through Make-A-Wish. He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

title: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat of 'Ghajini', 'Lagaan' fame passes away after battle with cancer
content: Renowned veteran actor Pradeep Rawat, celebrated for his iconic villain roles, has passed away at the age of seventy-four. His death occurred on the evening of August 4, 2026, as announced by his Lagaan co-star Yashpal Sharma. Rawat's remarkable contributions in both Hindi and South Indian cinema were matched only by his genuine humility and strong on-screen presence. He leaves behind a lasting legacy.

title: Tom Selleck's quote on self-improvement and pushing beyond your limits
content: Hollywood artist Tom Selleck achieved fame through his acting skills and screen presence.  His career spanned decades, including iconic roles in television and film.  Selleck's quote emphasizes continuous improvement and realizing one's full potential.  He began his acting journey after encouragement from fraternity brothers at USC.  The actor remains a respected figure with a significant net worth and philanthropic efforts.

title: Pak drone spotted in Kathua amid reports of Islamabad's military build-up along border
content: A Pakistani drone was spotted over Kathua's Hiranagar sector, prompting a security search.  Security forces also conducted a large anti-terror operation in Poonch district.  An unexploded mortar shell was recovered from a house in Kathua.  These events occur amid heightened tensions along the India-Pakistan border.  India stated it will safeguard its national interests as needed.

title: Child protection panel launches inquiry into Meta over alleged child sexual abuse material ads
content: The NCPCR has initiated a formal investigation following alarming claims from a BBC report which suggested that advertisements on Meta’s platforms like Instagram were linked to the promotion of child abuse material. In response, the child rights organization has demanded clarity from Meta Platforms Inc. Furthermore, the NHRC has instructed the Delhi Police to look into these troubling assertions, as both entities scrutinize Meta's adherence to child protection regulations.

title: 'It's my fault': Stokes blames himself for McCullum's England Test coach exit
content: Former England captain Ben Stokes desires to coach the national team in the future. He is currently pursuing his Level Three coaching qualification while still playing. Stokes confirmed his international playing career has concluded, dismissing Ashes return speculation. He expressed surprise at Joe Root's appointment as Test captain over Harry Brook. Stokes praised Stephen Fleming as the new Test coach and wished Root success.

title: 'A rebirth for us': Passengers recall chaos after Air India flight hits turbulence
content: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi encountered severe turbulence on Tuesday morning. The aircraft briefly lost altitude, causing injuries to 17 passengers and crew members. One cabin crew member sustained severe injuries, while others had minor wounds. Passengers described the terrifying ordeal, with some being thrown from their seats. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has launched a thorough investigation into the incident.

title: Will Nifty & Sensex continue to diverge? What new stock market timings mean
content: As per SEBI guidelines, a new Closing Auction Session has been introduced for eligible stocks, where continuous trading will halt at 3:15 PM instead of 3:30 PM. This has altered the final closing price calculation methodology for several stocks.

title: 54 bank fraud accused fled India, ED seizes assets worth over Rs 35,000 crore
content: The Enforcement Directorate is investigating 32 bank fraud cases with 54 absconding accused.  Proceedings under the Fugitive Economic Offenders Act have been launched against 27 individuals.  Assets worth over Rs 840 crore have been confiscated after nine were declared offenders.  Unclaimed bank deposits transferred to the RBI fund total Rs 62,683.19 crore.  India's foreign exchange reserves remain comfortable, covering 10.3 months of goods imports.

title: Kangana, Khushbu Sundar support Udhayanidhi Stalin's arrest, slam his comments on Trisha
content: Kangana Ranaut and Khushbu Sundar expressed strong disapproval of Udhayanidhi Stalin's recent comments, which led to his arrest and subsequent bail. Stalin’s remarks arose during a DMK protest about water disputes, provoking backlash from the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam party, who accused him of objectifying women. This incident has ignited a considerable political controversy and public discourse.

title: Odisha’s Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining): Eligibility, process, purpose explained
content: Odisha's Pucca Ghar Yojana is designed to provide durable housing solutions for eligible kutcha households. The initiative focuses on 36 blocks within nine mineral-rich districts impacted by mining. Beneficiaries will receive financial aid for construction, along with assistance for essential services like toilets. To determine eligibility, thorough surveys and checks against existing housing schemes are conducted, with registration available online or via local government officials.

title: ‘Respectful language should still be maintained’: Ex-India captain on abuse against PM Modi
content: Former India football captain Bhaichung Bhutia said citizens have the right to protest but should avoid abusive language, especially against the Prime Minister. Manu Bhaker also urged youngsters to use respectful words. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, meanwhile, said he did not want the protesters punished, calling their actions mistakes and hoping they would learn from them.

title: From apps to 'intent': How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑gen phones
content: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: Student housing is India's next real estate hotspot, says report - here's why
content: The surge in India's higher education landscape is driving a notable increase in demand for student accommodation. With international universities thriving and overseas education expenses rising, a remarkable demographic shift is anticipated, projecting over 70 million students by 2035. This educational migration will generate massive housing needs, prompting a significant boost in institutional investments aimed at nationwide accommodation development.

title: 'Will do whatever is necessary': India after Pak deploys 250 Chinese Howitzers
content: India stated it will protect national interests after Pakistan deployed Chinese artillery guns.  Pakistan has reportedly deployed around 250 Chinese-made SH-15 artillery systems.  India criticized Pakistan's recent elections in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir as a farce.  The spokesperson noted civilian deaths during a crackdown in the region.  Both nations continue to modernize their respective artillery capabilities.

title: Vedika Pinto recalls Anurag Kashyap's advice that led her to 'Musafir Cafe'
content: Musafir Cafe breakout star Vedika Pinto tells mid-day how her Nishaanchi director Anurag Kashyap encouraged her to take on the Netflix series, why the show has given her something Nishaanchi couldn't, and what it was like working with National Award winner Vikrant Massey.

title: 'Why the hurry?' Punjab passes anti-E20 resolution, says Centre under US pressure
content: Punjab's Assembly passed a resolution opposing the Centre's E20 fuel policy.  Concerns were raised about potential vehicle damage from the higher ethanol blend.  The state questioned the accelerated rollout and alleged external pressure influenced the decision.  The Aam Aadmi Party is campaigning nationwide against the policy.  They demand consumer choice and lower prices for the blended fuel.

title: Jannat Zubair calls link-up rumours with Elvish Yadav 'a little too much'
content: Jannat Zubair has recently commented on the swirling rumors about her possible romance with Elvish Yadav. While she appreciates the affection shown through fan edits and tribute pages, she emphasizes the need to maintain a clear boundary between professional interactions and personal life. As Yadav gears up for his Bollywood debut, Zubair wishes for their on-screen chemistry to stay just that—on-screen.

title: Rs 15.56 crore: The money behind the medal at 2026 CWG
content: India's 39-medal Commonwealth Games campaign highlighted the impact of the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), which funds elite athletes through customised training, competition exposure and sports science support. This TimesofIndia.com explainer details how athletes are selected, funded and reviewed, while outlining the government's enhanced investment in high-performance sport as India builds towards the 2036 Games ambitions.

title: Jensen Huang on Asian parenting: 5 lessons from Nvidia CEO's childhood remarks
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang shared how his Asian parents' constant feedback shaped him.  He explained their criticism was a unique way of showing love and care.  This upbringing taught him to embrace criticism and remain humble throughout his career.  Huang now applies these lessons to his leadership style at Nvidia.  His story highlights the importance of balanced feedback in child development.

title: 'RSS involvement in Sainik Schools rising', says Rahul; Parl panel chief seeks proof
content: Rahul Gandhi alleged increasing RSS involvement in Sainik Schools during a committee meeting. He referred to a media report while making his claim to the panel. The committee chair asked Rahul Gandhi to provide supporting documents for his allegations. Other BJP members also questioned the basis of his statements. Gandhi has previously accused the RSS of capturing public institutions.

title: Spices coated in cloth dye, talcum powder? Hyderabad raids expose food adulteration
content: Over 25,000 kg of hazardous chemical-laced spices were seized during raids. Three people were arrested after inspections uncovered alarming non-compliance with food safety laws. Dangerous practices involved synthetic chemicals, cloth dyes, and shining powder in spices. Strict legal proceedings are initiated against violating business owners under the Food Safety Act. Enforcement drives will continue to ensure safe, unadulterated food products reach consumers.

title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on UPI; what it means
content: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is the fee merchants pay to banks and payment service providers for processing digital transactions. In India, credit card payments generally attract an MDR of around 1.5%.

title: 'Madrassa pass-outs develop terrorist-like mindset': UP deputy CM Keshav Maurya
content: Speaking to reporters at Vidhan Bhavan, Maurya alleged that madrassa students do not express patriotic slogans and linked their education to extremism. "Anyone who receives a madrassa education does not chant 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' nor sing 'Vande Mataram', and develops a terrorist-like mindset," he was quoted as saying by news agency PTI. The remarks were strongly criticised by senior Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav.

title: Govt dismisses reports of fuel quality issues, says checks on
